subject: Render DELTA5 READY FOR REVIEW: pass inert + depth/stencil exact subset
body:
DELTA5 is ready for review, no commit. Changed production: gpu/metal/nord2_render_pass.inc, gpu/metal/tegu/render_encoder.inc, gpu/metal/tegu/render_pipeline.inc, gpu/metal/tegu/ws_selector_compat.inc. Worker test: host_test_vs_texture.py.

COMMAND/RESULT: python3 build/deepseek-parallel-20261025/workers/render/host_test_vs_texture.py -> rc0, both fake-JM binaries PASS under ASan+UBSan (__asan linked), 16 PASS_REFUSED per process. It proves nonnil inert encoders for sample4/resolve/mismatch/depth-store/stencil-store; all 14 RenderBox selectors + viewport/scissor; end/commit error; DontCare depth+stencil no-test draw status4; enabled-stencil draw refused count1/status4/rc=-14; depthFormat252/stencilFormat253 PSO accepted. Prior delta4 tests remain green. ARM64 JM -Werror syntax PASS no suppression; bridge syntax PASS; iosurface CPU PASS; diffcheck clean.

LIMITATIONS: normal depth/stencil store (non-DontCare), resolve, MSAA, extra/mismatched attachments, renderTargetArrayLength>1, visibilityResultBuffer are inert/Error. Depth/stencil execution is not implemented; only the exact DontCare + no-test/no-write subset renders. JM PSOs accept depth/stencil formats 250..255/260 to avoid QuartzCore PSO nil abort, but no depth hardware is claimed. Non-JM behavior unchanged. frontend_jm_test.py still links the stale research/nord2-host-air lib and lacks current planner symbols; worker host uses current bridge/Mesa libs.

Please review the new nord2_render_pass.inc ownership explicitly (roles.json predates TASK.md naming it), and align integration_tests with the DontCare subset. No native/phone/publish/commit.
